videos.description: Exploring the legend of Matilda Sorrel and her ties to the historic Sorrel-Weed House in Savannah, Georgia; getting chills when Shane, Dave, and Cindy visit this former estate and discover things.

videos.description: Visit a shrine where all faiths converge, then stand back as the team discovers a tear in its spiritual shield; witness a ritual; watch hidden secrets surface.
